text: Month six. (pause 0.4) Bank officers at your door. They take possession. A notice goes up on your wall. (pause 0.4) Your name. Your address. Printed in two newspapers... one in your own language. (pause 0.4) The whole colony reads it... with their morning chai. (pause 0.5) Thirty days later, your home can go to auction. {neutral} One fair rule: if it sells for more than you owe, the extra money usually comes back to you.
